name: Wandering Shell
description: One armored shell guards a box somewhere on the grid. Tap its neighbors to hit it — but after every hit it leaps to a completely different area.
howToPlay: Find the steel plate (shows a number 3→2→1). Tap any box next to it to deal damage. After each hit it jumps far away — track it down and hit it 3 times total to shatter it and free the box underneath.
author: Claude

showcaseLevel.name: Wandering Shell Demo
showcaseLevel.desc: Track it down — it won't stay still!
